content.text:
I'm leaning towards an S&P 500 track, probably Menora's (מנורה מבטחים, track 13874). It had the lowest fee of any S&P one I spotted, 0.52%. Its return looked about the same as the others, around 13.8% "3 שנים". It's a name I know from ads. But I'm not opening anything tonight. I'm unsure, and the 0.52% is what tipped it.

**Where I looked, in order:**
- **First screen.** The big heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the green "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button. Good, it's the right thing. Then "143 מסלולים של 12 חברות", and I thought: 143? Seriously?
- **The topic buttons.** I saw "עוקב מדד s&p 500 12". That's the one I'd have pressed to cut it down to 12. I couldn't press it here, so I kept scrolling the full list.
- **The list, by company.** Each company has a header row, then its tracks. I mostly stopped on the S&P rows and the big green numbers:
  - הראל S&P: 0.56%, 13.7%
  - מור S&P: 0.71%, 13.74%
  - מיטב S&P: 0.6%, 13.87%
  - אלטשולר S&P: 0.54%, but "פחות מ־3 שנים", so no return at all
  - הפניקס S&P: 0.58%, 13.31%
  - מגדל S&P: 0.57%, 13.65%
  - כלל S&P: 0.59%, 13.39%
  - מנורה S&P: 0.52%, 13.79%
- **Something that caught my eye.** "26.39%" on a "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" row, maybe אנליסט, I'm not sure which company that row is under. And "24.04%" on הראל מניות. Those are way higher, which made me wonder if S&P is even the best. I don't know what "גמיש" means, so I left it.
- **By around screen 3 or 4 I was bored stiff.** It's the same row over and over. I'd have closed it there on the bus. I only thumbed down to the end because I wanted to see every company.

**What I skipped:** The grey intro text. The yellow box ("נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו..."), apart from noticing it was a warning. The line under the topic buttons. The note at the bottom about returns. "חוקים וכללים". The footer.

**Words I didn't get:** "מט״ח" with the percentages next to the circles (what does 99% מט״ח mean?), "מההפקדה" vs "מהחיסכון", "גמיש", "כספי (שקלי)", "הלכה יהודית", "אג״ח ממשלתי סחיר", and "123 מקור / מחושב / הזנחה".

**What bothered me:**
- Every row repeats the same words: "מהחיסכון / מההפקדות", "מניות / מט״ח" with the colour dots, "פחות מ־3 שנים / פחות מ־5 שנים". I had to read past all of that every time just to find the one number that's different. Once at the top would have done.
- The same tracks show up again under every company, but they aren't next to each other. To compare S&P with S&P I had to scroll the whole page and remember the numbers.
- The S&P track has a slightly different name at almost every company (s&p500, S&P 500, S&P500), so spotting them is extra work.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" sits where the number should be. It looks like a value, but there's no number in it. At first I read it as some kind of score.
- The orange "עוד לא דווח" with the ! icon scared me off those rows, and there are lots of them at מגדל and at אילון, a name I've never heard of.
- The yellow "לא עודכנו" warning at the top made me trust the numbers less.
- The fees are all about 0.5–0.7%, which sounds like nothing. I can't tell if the difference matters.
